claims.claim: The Carretera Austral is Ruta 7, a principal longitudinal route through Chilean Patagonia connecting territories in Los Lagos and Aysén.
claims.authority: Ministerio de Obras Públicas de Chile

claims.claim: The Plan Ruta Austral: Soberanía que conecta is a 2026-2030 public investment program centered on Ruta 7 and associated austral connectivity infrastructure.
claims.authority: Ministerio de Obras Públicas de Chile

claims.claim: The plan announced investment close to CLP 800 billion and intervention across 244 km, with road, maritime and lacustrine projects.
claims.authority: Ministerio de Obras Públicas de Chile
claims.verification_rule: Re-check against MOP for later execution or budget changes.

claims.claim: The Chilean state explicitly associates investment in the Carretera Austral with connectivity, territorial integration, sovereignty, regional development and tourism.
claims.authority: Ministerio de Obras Públicas de Chile

claims.claim: EL PAÍS framed the Carretera Austral in September 2026 as a route that opens access to the 'end of the world', a useful signal of international narrative positioning for Chilean Patagonia.
